name: Cafe Bettina
beschreibung: The Cafe Bettina in the village of Ellmau is run as an inn with an attached café. The accommodation includes several guest rooms as well as holiday apartments. The café serves homemade Mehlspeisen and traditional Tiroler dishes. The location in the Kaiserwinkl-Region makes excursions into the Kitzbüheler Alpen possible. The inn offers both overnight stays and a cozy café.
